status: PROPOSED - NOT APPROVED. Candidates from the S8 governance document (D4, §4A).

phase_rules.REVIEW: status is OPEN or SATISFIED; SATISFIED needs non-empty evidence and is set only through a reviewed change, never by a tool
phase_rules.ARTIFACT: status is always PRODUCED_AT_STAGE; the harness verifies it (PRE_EXECUTION: named verifier over real files, the build-input fingerprint and the local images; ACCEPTANCE: a regular JSON file); the lock can never claim it
phase_rules.PRE_BUILD: must be fully satisfied before an approved construction step (harness.py build)
phase_rules.PRE_EXECUTION: must be satisfied, together with PRE_BUILD, before harness.py run; produced by the build plus review
phase_rules.ACCEPTANCE: after the run; never gates build or run; reported as open until produced and reviewed
